article.title: Data Leakage and Time-Aware Validation in Predictive Models

paragraphs.en: A predictive model may look impressive during development and disappoint after deployment. One possible cause is data leakage: information unavailable at prediction time accidentally enters training or validation. Leakage lets a model exploit clues from the future, the target itself, or processing decisions that use evaluation data. The reported accuracy then describes an unrealistic task. Preventing leakage requires more than removing suspicious columns. Analysts must reconstruct what was actually known at each decision point and design their entire pipeline around that timeline. They should also distinguish a legitimate historical feature from a field that was backfilled later, because the two may look identical in a current database snapshot.
paragraphs.zh: 預測模型開發表現亮眼、上線卻失敗，可能是資料洩漏：預測時不可得資訊進入訓練或驗證。模型利用未來、目標或評估資料處理的線索，讓分數不真實。應重建決策時點已知資訊，並區分當時存在的歷史特徵與後來回填欄位，即使現在資料庫看起來一樣。
paragraphs.ja: 予測時点では利用できない情報が学習に入ると評価が高く見えます。現在のデータベースにある値でも、当時存在したか、後から補完されたかを確認します。

paragraphs.en: Imagine a company predicting which customers will purchase insurance within the next thirty days. The prediction is supposed to be made on the first day of each month. A feature showing activity during the following week would be invalid, even if it appears in a convenient monthly summary. Likewise, a field updated after a contract is signed might reveal the target indirectly. Analysts should define an as-of date and ensure every feature reflects information available no later than that date. The feature's business meaning is not enough; its actual update timestamp matters. If a data source arrives with a delay, the model must respect the time it became accessible, not merely the date of the underlying event.
paragraphs.zh: 假設每月一日預測未來三十天的保險購買，包含後續一週活動的特徵無效。簽約後更新欄位也可能間接透露結果。應定義 as-of 日期，檢查實際更新時間；若資料延遲到達，應以當時可存取時間而非事件發生日判斷。
paragraphs.ja: 毎月一日時点の予測なら翌週の行動を入れてはいけません。データ到着が遅れる場合、イベント日だけでなく利用可能になった時刻も確認します。

paragraphs.en: Temporal validation addresses a related problem. Randomly splitting records may place later observations in training while earlier ones remain in testing. This can exaggerate performance when customer behavior, pricing, or business rules change. A chronological split trains on earlier periods and evaluates on later periods, reflecting future deployment more closely. However, a time split alone cannot repair a leaked feature. Data construction must respect the as-of boundary for every record. A realistic evaluation needs both a correct timeline and appropriate feature availability. When outcomes require thirty days to mature, the evaluation should also prevent incomplete labels near the boundary from contaminating comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 隨機切分可能讓晚期資料進訓練、早期進測試，當行為或規則改變時高估表現。時間切分較接近部署，但不能修復洩漏特徵。每筆資料須遵守 as-of 邊界；若結果需三十天成熟，也要避免邊界附近未完成標籤污染比較。
paragraphs.ja: 時系列分割だけでは特徴量リークを防げません。結果が確定するまで三十日かかるなら、境界付近の未確定ラベルにも注意します。

paragraphs.en: Preprocessing can leak information too. Suppose an analyst calculates a global average or selects variables using the entire dataset before dividing it into training and testing portions. The test set has influenced the transformation or feature selection, so evaluation is no longer independent. Fit preprocessing on training data only and apply the learned transformations to validation data. Cross-validation requires the same discipline within each fold. This is especially important for target encoding, feature selection, imputation, and normalization procedures whose parameters depend on observed data. A reusable pipeline helps enforce the correct order and makes mistakes easier to audit.
paragraphs.zh: 前處理也可能洩漏。若切分前用全資料計算平均或選變數，測試集已影響轉換。應只在訓練集擬合前處理，再套用到驗證集；交叉驗證每折也一樣。目標編碼、特徵選擇、補值、標準化尤其重要。可重複使用的流程有助稽核順序。
paragraphs.ja: 前処理を全データで学習するとテスト情報が混入します。各分割の学習データだけで変換を学び、検証側に適用します。

paragraphs.en: Repeated entities introduce another risk. If the same customer appears in training and testing, a model may recognize stable personal patterns rather than generalize to new customers. Whether that is a problem depends on intended deployment. Predicting future behavior for existing customers differs from predicting behavior for people never seen before. The validation scheme should match the population and time horizon the model will face. Group-based splitting may be necessary for some use cases, while rolling-origin evaluation may be appropriate for recurring monthly predictions. No single split is universally correct; the deployment question determines the design.
paragraphs.zh: 同一客戶出現在訓練與測試可能讓模型記住個人模式。是否有問題取決於用途：既有客戶未來預測與全新客戶預測不同。驗證應符合部署族群與期間，有時用群組切分，有時用滾動時間驗證；沒有萬用切法。
paragraphs.ja: 同じ顧客が両方に現れる問題は用途次第です。既存顧客の将来予測と新規顧客への一般化では分割方法が異なります。

paragraphs.en: Teams should document the prediction timestamp, outcome window, feature extraction logic, preprocessing order, and validation split. A practical leakage audit asks whether a feature could be reconstructed using only records available at the time. Analysts can compare unusually powerful features with operational workflows to identify suspicious update patterns. They should evaluate performance on a later untouched period and monitor the model after launch. A lower but realistic validation score is more useful than an impressive number dependent on impossible access to future information. Trustworthy evaluation begins with an honest reconstruction of the decision environment.
paragraphs.zh: 團隊應記錄預測時點、結果期間、特徵抽取、前處理順序與切分。稽核可問：只用當時存在的紀錄能否重建特徵？也應檢查異常強特徵，在未碰過的較晚期間評估並上線監控。較低但真實的分數比依賴未來資訊的漂亮分數有用。
paragraphs.ja: 予測時刻、目的変数の期間、特徴量生成、前処理、分割を記録します。当時の情報だけで再現できるか確認し、後続期間でも評価します。
